sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血液已被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于得知了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案呈现”的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: It was a crisp spring night on May 13, 1974, when a young woman walked out of a Salzburg bar with a smartly dressed stranger.
sentences.zh: 那是1974年5月13日一个清爽的春夜，一名年轻女子和一个衣着考究的陌生人走出了萨尔茨堡的一家酒吧。

sentences.en: Julia, not her real name, had started chatting to the man after he initiated a conversation with her.
sentences.zh: 朱莉（化名）是在这名男子主动搭讪后开始和他聊天的。

sentences.en: Although they had just met, Julia was more than impressed with his charming and talkative manner.
sentences.zh: 尽管刚见面，但朱莉对他的迷人和健谈印象深刻。

sentences.en: As he led Julia outside, he offered her a lift home, gesturing to his expensive Ford
sentences.zh: 当他领着朱莉走到外面时，示意停在街对面的那辆昂贵的福特

sentences.en: Mustang parked across the street.
sentences.zh: 野马跑车，并提出开车送她回家。

sentences.en: Accepting his offer, Julia hopped into the car's passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 朱莉接受了邀请，坐进了副驾驶座。

sentences.en: As the Mustang drove away from the bright lights of Salzburg and into the surrounding countryside,
sentences.zh: 野马车驶离萨尔茨堡灯火辉煌的市区，进入周边的乡村，

sentences.en: Julia realised that the man was driving in the opposite direction of her home.
sentences.zh: 朱莉意识到这个男人开车的方向与她家完全相反。

sentences.en: She began to panic.
sentences.zh: 她开始惊慌失措。

sentences.en: They headed down a small laneway and into a meadow surrounded by dense bushes.
sentences.zh: 他们驶入一条小巷，来到一片四周环绕着茂密灌木丛的草地上。

sentences.en: It was completely deserted.
sentences.zh: 这里荒无人烟。

sentences.en: With no streetlights to illuminate the area, all was pitch black outside.
sentences.zh: 周围没有路灯照明，外面漆黑一片。

sentences.en: Julia's fear grew.
sentences.zh: 朱莉的恐惧愈发浓烈。

sentences.en: Then, just as the man drove deeper into the field, the car became stuck in the mud.
sentences.zh: 就在男子将车开进田野深处时，车子突然陷进了泥里。

sentences.en: Suddenly, they stopped.
sentences.zh: 车子猛地停了下来。

sentences.en: As the Mustang's wheels turned and turned without gaining any traction, Julia saw her chance.
sentences.zh: 野马车的车轮空转着却无法借力，朱莉看到了逃跑的机会。

sentences.en: She leapt from the passenger seat and began sprinting across the field.
sentences.zh: 她从副驾驶座跳下来，开始在田野里飞奔。

sentences.en: But the man followed.
sentences.zh: 但男子追了上来。

sentences.en: He was quick, catching up in no time and tackling her to the ground.
sentences.zh: 他速度极快，转眼间就追了上来，将她扑倒在地。

sentences.en: He shoved her face in the mud to silence her screams, then began beating the back of her head.
sentences.zh: 他把她的脸按在泥里以阻止她尖叫，然后开始殴打她的后脑勺。

sentences.en: After he roughly removed her shoes, he tore off her stockings and used them to bind her hands behind her back.
sentences.zh: 他粗暴地脱掉她的鞋子，扯下她的长袜，并用长袜将她的双手反绑在背后。

sentences.en: Dragging Julia back to the car, the man sexually assaulted her with a steel pole while he masturbated.
sentences.zh: 男子将朱莉拖回车旁，一边自慰，一边用一根钢管对她实施了性侵。

sentences.en: When he was finished, he freed Julia from her restraint.
sentences.zh: 完事后，他解开了束缚朱莉的绳索。

sentences.en: Headlights suddenly illuminated the field behind them.
sentences.zh: 耀眼的车灯突然照亮了他们身后的田野。

sentences.en: Another car had pulled up to the scene.
sentences.zh: 另一辆车开到了现场。

sentences.en: It's occupants had noticed the Mustang stuck in the mud and the driver walked over to assiSt.
sentences.zh: 车上的人注意到那辆陷入泥潭的野马车，司机便走过来提供帮助。

sentences.en: Julia's attacker got out and greeted him, feigning distress over his car's state.
sentences.zh: 朱莉的袭击者下了车并迎了上去，假装为自己车子的状况感到苦恼。

sentences.en: As they spoke, Julia saw her second chance to escape.
sentences.zh: 在他们交谈时，朱莉看到了她的第二次逃生机会。

sentences.en: She clambered out of the Mustang and raced over to the other car, frantically asking the passenger to take her to the police.
sentences.zh: 她爬出野马车，冲向另一辆车，拼命请求乘客带她去找警察。

sentences.en: He agreed and called over the driver so they could leave immediately.
sentences.zh: 那人同意了，并叫过司机以便他们立刻离开。

sentences.en: As they pulled away, carrying Julia to safety, their car's headlights cast a bright light over her attacker in the meadow.
sentences.zh: 当他们开车离去、将朱莉带往安全地带时，车灯在田野里的袭击者身上投下耀眼的光芒。

sentences.en: He stared back, still standing next to the Ford Mustang, stuck deep in the mud.
sentences.zh: 他站在深陷泥潭的福特野马旁，回望着他们。

sentences.en: Seven months after the attack on Julia, 18-year-old Margaret Schaffer said goodbye to her friends after spending the evening bowling with them and began to walk home.
sentences.zh: 在袭击朱莉七个月后，18岁的玛格丽特·沙弗和朋友们保龄球聚会后道别，开始步行回家。

sentences.en: Margaret lived in Eversbach, Germany, approximately 650 kilometres north of the Austrian city of Salzburg.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特住在德国埃弗斯巴赫，距离奥地利城市萨尔茨堡以北约650公里。

sentences.en: As she strolled along the footpath, a Mercedes pulled up alongside her.
sentences.zh: 正当她在人行道上散步时，一辆奔驰车在她身旁停下。

sentences.en: Glancing inside, Margaret saw her friend Barbara sitting in the passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特往车里一瞥，看见她的朋友芭芭拉正坐在副驾驶座上。

sentences.en: Barbara asked Margaret if she would like a lift home to save walking in the cold night air.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉问玛格丽特是否需要搭车回家，以免在寒冷的夜里步行。

sentences.en: Margaret gratefully agreed.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特感激地接受了。

sentences.en: Three weeks later, a group of hunters were navigating through a dense copse of trees in a wooded area outside of the German town of Haerborn.
sentences.zh: 三周后，一群猎人在德国黑尔博恩镇外林区的一片茂密树林中穿行。

sentences.en: As they carefully made their way through the forest, they spotted something.
sentences.zh: 当他们小心翼翼地穿过森林时，他们发现了一些东西。

sentences.en: Lying face down beneath a tall conifer was the naked body of a woman.
sentences.zh: 一具女性裸尸正朝下趴在一棵高大的针叶树下。

sentences.en: Someone had tried to cover her with leaves and branches, but her skin and dark curly hair were still visible.
sentences.zh: 有人试图用树叶和树枝盖住她，但她的皮肤和黑色卷发依然清晰可见。

sentences.en: It was Margaret Schaffer.
sentences.zh: 她就是玛格丽特·沙弗。

sentences.en: Her wrists had been restrained before she was beaten about the head with a blunt object.
sentences.zh: 她的手腕在被钝器击打头部之前曾被绑住。

sentences.en: Then her attacker had used Margaret's own bra to strangle her.
sentences.zh: 随后，袭击者用玛格丽特自己的胸罩勒死了她。

sentences.en: It had been expertly tied in a unique series of knots to form an extremely taut ligature.
sentences.zh: 胸罩被巧妙地系成了一系列独特的结，形成了一条极其紧绷的勒带。

sentences.en: German detectives attended the location and commenced an investigation, making sure to interview those close to Margaret.
sentences.zh: 德国侦探赶到现场并展开调查，务必对接近玛格丽特的人进行了走访。

sentences.en: This led them to her friend, Barbara.
sentences.zh: 这让他们找到了她的朋友芭芭拉。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before she cracked under the pressure.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，她在压力下崩溃了。

sentences.en: 24-year-old Jack Unterweger was already well known to authorities in the neighbouring country of Austria.
sentences.zh: 24岁的杰克·翁特韦格早已为邻国奥地利的当局所熟知。

sentences.en: In 1970, Jack abducted a 16-year-old girl and tried to force her into sex work.
sentences.zh: 1970年，杰克绑架了一名16岁女孩，并企图逼良为娼。

sentences.en: His extensive rap sheet also featured charges for robbery, car theft, burglary, and fraud.
sentences.zh: 他长长的犯罪记录中还包括抢劫、偷车、入室盗窃和诈骗等多项罪名。

sentences.en: Over time, Jack added sexual assault to his long list of criminal convictions.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，杰克长长的犯罪清单上又添上了性侵这一罪名。

sentences.en: Women were easy targets for him.
sentences.zh: 女性对他是轻而易举的目标。

sentences.en: He presented himself as intelligent, gregarious, wealthy, and well-groomed, and was able to charm his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 他把自己包装成聪明、合群、富有且衣着得体的人，并得以迷住受害者。

sentences.en: Despite his urbane persona, the truth was that Jack was broke and could not read or write.
sentences.zh: 尽管有着温文尔雅的人设，但事实是杰克身无分文且不识字。

sentences.en: Throughout 1973 and 74, Jack's assaults landed him short stints in prison, but every time he was released, he attacked again.
sentences.zh: 在整个1973和1974年间，杰克的袭击行为让他屡次短暂入狱，但每次释放后他又再次作案。

sentences.en: Over time, his violence against women escalated, like the time he attacked Julia in a field outside Salzburg.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，他对女性的暴力不断升级，就像他曾在萨尔茨堡郊外的田野里袭击朱莉那样。

sentences.en: Having gotten a good look at Jack, she quickly identified him as her attacker and he was sent to prison for the assault in mid-1974.
sentences.zh: 由于看清了杰克的长相，她很快认出他就是袭击者，他于1974年中期因这次袭击被判入狱。

sentences.en: After attempting to take his own life, Jack was transferred to a local psychiatric hospital.
sentences.zh: 在试图自杀后，杰克被转送到当地的一家精神病院。

sentences.en: A few months later, he was released and decided to make a fresh start in Frankfurt, Germany.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，他获释了，并决定在德国法兰克福重新开始。

sentences.en: It was there that he began dating a young woman named Barbara.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，他开始和一个名叫芭芭拉的年轻女子交往。

sentences.en: On the night of December 11, 1974, Jack and Barbara decided they needed some easy cash and hatched a plan to rob Barbara's parents.
sentences.zh: 1974年12月11日晚，杰克和芭芭拉决定搞点快钱，并密谋抢劫芭芭拉的父母。

sentences.en: They drove from Frankfurt to Barbara's hometown of Eversbach and headed directly to her family's house.
sentences.zh: 他们从法兰克福驱车前往芭芭拉的家乡埃弗斯巴赫，直奔她家。

sentences.en: They'd expected to find it empty, but to their dismay, Barbara's parents were home.
sentences.zh: 他们本以为家里没人，但令他们沮丧的是，芭芭拉的父母在家。

sentences.en: Their plan foiled, the couple began driving around town, looking for someone else to rob.
sentences.zh: 计划泡汤后，这对情侣开始在镇上开车兜风，寻找其他人进行抢劫。

sentences.en: Soon, they spotted Margaret Schaffer, walking all alone.
sentences.zh: 很快，他们发现了独自一人走路的玛格丽特·沙弗。

sentences.en: Barbara knew Margaret well, she had previously lived next door to her and the two were friends.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉很了解玛格丽特，她以前就住在她隔壁，两人是朋友。

sentences.en: Barbara told Jack as much and he hastily pulled over so they could offer Margaret a lift.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉把这事告诉了杰克，杰克赶紧把车停路边，以便他们邀请玛格丽特上车。

sentences.en: She happily accepted.
sentences.zh: 她高兴地接受了。

sentences.en: The two women chatted in the car's back seat while Jack drove.
sentences.zh: 两个女人坐在汽车后座上聊天，杰克负责开车。

sentences.en: After a little while, he stopped by the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，他在路边停下了车。

sentences.en: As recounted in the book Entering Hades by John Leake, Jack asked Barbara,
sentences.zh: 正如约翰·利克在书《进入哈迪斯》中所述，杰克问芭芭拉：

sentences.en: Do you have anything else you want to tell her?
sentences.zh: 你还有什么想对她说的吗？

sentences.en: When Barbara said no, Jack remarked,
sentences.zh: 当芭芭拉说没有时，杰克评论道：

sentences.en: Then now we'll get to the point.
sentences.zh: 那现在我们切入正题。

sentences.en: He grabbed Margaret by her shirt, finding her slim frame easy to pull into the front seat.
sentences.zh: 他抓住玛格丽特的衬衫，发觉她苗条的身躯很容易就能拉到前座。

sentences.en: Using Barbara's belt, he restrained Margaret's hands behind her back.
sentences.zh: 他用芭芭拉的皮带将玛格丽特的双手反绑在背后。

sentences.en: After rifling through her belongings and pocketing some cash, Jack drove to Margaret's house.
sentences.zh: 在搜查了她的随身物品并拿走一些现金后，杰克开车去了玛格丽特的家。

sentences.en: Barbara let herself inside with a key from Margaret's purse.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉用玛格丽特钱包里的钥匙自己开了门进去。

sentences.en: She wandered through the residence, pocketing about $40 from Margaret's room and grabbing some clothing as well.
sentences.zh: 她在住宅里转悠，从玛格丽特的房间拿走了大约40美元现金，还顺便拿了一些衣服。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Jack waited in the car with Margaret.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，杰克和玛格丽特在车里等待。

sentences.en: He had pushed her to the rear footwell and she was unable to move.
sentences.zh: 他把她推到了后座脚部空间，让她动弹不得。

sentences.en: When Barbara returned, Jack drove 30 kilometres south to Hairbourne, asking Barbara if she knew of any woodlands nearby.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉回来后，杰克向南驱车30公里来到黑尔博恩，问芭芭拉附近有没有什么树林。

sentences.en: As Margaret sobbed in the back of the car,
sentences.zh: 当玛格丽特在车后座啜泣时，

sentences.en: Barbara directed Jack past the restaurant and on to a forest road.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉指引杰克驶过餐馆，开上一条林间小路。

sentences.en: Jack drove deep into the woods, then parked the car.
sentences.zh: 杰克将车开进树林深处，然后停下车。

sentences.en: He untied Margaret and ordered her to take her clothes off, but she refused.
sentences.zh: 他给玛格丽特松绑并命令她脱衣服，但她拒绝了。

sentences.en: Jack punched her in the face before undressing her himself.
sentences.zh: 杰克一拳打在她脸上，然后亲手剥光了她的衣服。

sentences.en: When he hopped out of the car, Margaret asked Barbara what he was going to do to her.
sentences.zh: 当他跳下车时，玛格丽特问芭芭拉他打算对她做什么。

sentences.en: Barbara just shrugged in reply.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉只是耸了耸肩作答。

sentences.en: Jack reappeared and grabbed a steel rod from the glove box, then dragged Margaret from the car.
sentences.zh: 杰克重新出现，从杂物箱里拿出一根钢筋，然后把玛格丽特从车里拖了出去。

sentences.en: He asked Barbara if she'd like to accompany him.
sentences.zh: 他问芭芭拉是否想跟他一起去。

sentences.en: She declined, but watched as Jack dragged a naked Margaret across the snow-covered ground.
sentences.zh: 她拒绝了，但看着杰克把赤身裸体的玛格丽特拖过覆盖着积雪的地面。

sentences.en: They disappeared into a thicket of nearby trees.
sentences.zh: 他们消失在附近的一片树丛中。

sentences.en: In a statement, Barbara later told detectives,
sentences.zh: 在一份声明中，芭芭拉后来告诉侦探：

sentences.en: I was terribly afraid for her, but also for myself.
sentences.zh: 我为她感到极其害怕，但也为我自己感到害怕。

sentences.en: About 15 minutes later, he came back to the car, and after he sat in the driver's seat, he handed me the steel rod, which was covered with blood and hair.
sentences.zh: 大约15分钟后，他回到了车里，坐上驾驶座后，他把那根沾满血迹和头发的钢筋递给了我。

sentences.en: What did you do with her?
sentences.zh: 你把她怎么了？

sentences.en: I asked him.
sentences.zh: 我问他。

sentences.en: He replied,
sentences.zh: 他回答说：

sentences.en: While there was no physical evidence from the crime scene linking Jack to the murder, his girlfriend Barbara's confession was enough to warrant action.
sentences.zh: 虽然现场没有将杰克与这起谋杀案联系起来的物证，但其女友芭芭拉的供词足以采取行动。

sentences.en: On January 17, 1975, just a month after Margaret's murder,
sentences.zh: 1975年1月17日，即玛格丽特遇害仅一个月后，

sentences.en: Jack Unterweger was arrested and charged.
sentences.zh: 杰克·翁特韦格被捕并被起诉。

sentences.en: Due to a treaty between Germany and Austria, Jack, an Austrian citizen, would be tried in his homeland despite killing Margaret in Germany.
sentences.zh: 根据德国和奥地利之间的条约，杰克作为奥地利公民，尽管是在德国杀人，但仍将在他的祖国受审。

sentences.en: It is unclear whether his girlfriend Barbara faced any legal ramifications for her actions on the night of Margaret's murder.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚他的女友芭芭拉是否因在玛格丽特遇害当晚的行为而面临任何法律后果。

sentences.en: In July 1975, while still waiting for Margaret Schaffer's murder trial to begin,
sentences.zh: 1975年7月，在等待玛格丽特·沙弗谋杀案审判开始期间，

sentences.en: Jack Unterweger was tried for violent offences against four other women in Austria.
sentences.zh: 杰克·翁特韦格因在奥地利对另外四名女性实施暴力犯罪而受审。

sentences.en: He was found guilty and sentenced to three years in prison.
sentences.zh: 他被判有罪，并被判处三年监禁。

sentences.en: One year into his sentence, the murder trial finally commenced.
sentences.zh: 服刑一年后，谋杀案审判终于开庭。

sentences.en: In court, Jack wore a dark suit with a gaudy tie, while his long, shaggy hair fell around his face.
sentences.zh: 在法庭上，杰克穿着深色西装，系着俗气的领带，长长的蓬乱头发披散在脸旁。

sentences.en: Short, slim and baby-faced, with delicate features and small, wide eyes,
sentences.zh: 身材矮小苗条、长着一张娃娃脸，五官清秀，小小的眼睛睁得圆圆的，

sentences.en: Jack Unterweger didn't look like a stereotypical criminal.
sentences.zh: 杰克·翁特韦格看起来一点也不像刻板印象中的罪犯。

sentences.en: The prosecution instructed those present to look beyond his appearance as they heard the evidence against him.
sentences.zh: 在听取针对他的证据时，控方指示在场人员不要被他的外表所迷惑。

sentences.en: The trial drew a large crowd.
sentences.zh: 庭审吸引了大量旁听者。

sentences.en: They listened attentively as Jack's defence team spoke of his troubled childhood.
sentences.zh: 他们全神贯注地听着杰克的辩护团队讲述他坎坷的童年。

sentences.en: He was born in 1950 in the historic Austrian town of Udenborg.
sentences.zh: 他于1950年出生在奥地利历史名镇乌登堡。

sentences.en: His mother was a waitress and sex worker.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲是一名女服务员和性工作者。

sentences.en: Jack's father, who he never met, was an American soldier.
sentences.zh: 杰克的父亲是一名美国士兵，他从未见过对方。

sentences.en: He'd been part of a group of US troops occupying the area following the end of World War II.
sentences.zh: 对方曾是二战结束后来该地区占领此地的美军部队中的一员。

sentences.en: When Jack was about 18 months old, his mother was jailed for fraud and he was sent to live with his grandfather in a desolate, run-down cottage in the Austrian countryside.
sentences.zh: 杰克大约18个月大时，他的母亲因诈骗入狱，他被送到奥地利乡下一座荒凉破败的小屋里跟外祖父一起生活。

sentences.en: It was during this time that Jack struggled the moSt.
sentences.zh: 正是在这段时间里，杰克过得最艰难。

sentences.en: His grandfather was a violent alcoholic who beat Jack for misbehaving.
sentences.zh: 他的外祖父是一个有暴力倾向的酒鬼，因为杰克不听话而殴打他。

sentences.en: Jack often claimed that he was forced to sleep in the same bed as his grandfather while the elderly man had sex with various girlfriends and sex workers.
sentences.zh: 杰克经常声称，当这位老汉与不同的女友和性工作者发生性关系时，他被迫和外祖父睡在同一张床上。

sentences.en: However, this was likely not true, with many of Jack's stories about his childhood being embellished and exaggerated for sympathy.
sentences.zh: 然而，这很可能并非事实，杰克关于童年的许多故事都是为了博取同情而添油加醋、夸大其词的。

sentences.en: Ever since his arrest, Jack Unterweger had denied murdering Margaret Schaffer.
sentences.zh: 自被捕以来，杰克·翁特韦格一直否认谋杀玛格丽特·沙弗。

sentences.en: But on the stand, he suddenly broke down.
sentences.zh: 但在证人席上，他突然崩溃了。

sentences.en: He admitted to beating Margaret and then strangling her with her own bra.
sentences.zh: 他承认殴打了玛格丽特，然后用她自己的胸罩勒死了她。

sentences.en: When he'd looked into her face, he saw his mother's, which caused him to explode with rage and hatred.
sentences.zh: 当他看着她的脸时，他看到了他母亲的脸，这导致他怒火中烧、充满仇恨。

sentences.en: Jack sobbed and pleaded for forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 杰克失声痛哭并恳求宽恕。

sentences.en: Instead of being forgiven, he was found guilty and given a life sentence to be served at Stein Prison, a maximum security facility in Krems, Austria.
sentences.zh: 非但没有得到宽恕，他反而被判有罪，并在奥地利克雷姆斯的高安全级别监狱——施泰因监狱被判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: Police inspector August Schenner sat in the courtroom listening to Jack Unterweger's sentencing with intereSt.
sentences.zh: 警长奥古斯特·申纳坐在法庭里，饶有兴致地听着杰克·翁特韦格的宣判。

sentences.en: The murder of Margaret Schaffer bore strong similarities to a case that had landed on his desk three years earlier.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·沙弗的谋杀案与三年前摆在他桌上的一起案件有着惊人的相似之处。

sentences.en: On April 1, 1973, the body of a petite woman with long black hair was found floating in a lake in Salzburg.
sentences.zh: 1973年4月1日，人们在萨尔茨堡的一个湖泊中发现了一具漂浮的、留着长黑发的小巧女性尸体。

sentences.en: Aged in her mid-twenties, she wore a turtleneck jumper and was naked from the waist down.
sentences.zh: 她二十多岁，穿着高领套头衫，腰部以下赤裸。

sentences.en: The woman's ankles had been tied together tightly with her stockings, and her wrists bound expertly behind her back with a necktie.
sentences.zh: 这名女性的脚踝被她的长袜紧紧绑在一起，手腕则被一条领带巧妙地反绑在背后。

sentences.en: A bandage, likely taken from a car's first aid kit, was wrapped multiple times around her head and mouth, acting as a makeshift gag.
sentences.zh: 一条可能取自汽车急救包的绷带在她头部和嘴巴周围缠了好几圈，充当临时口塞。

sentences.en: She had been violently beaten across the face, but the cause of her death was drowning.
sentences.zh: 她的面部遭到过暴力殴打，但她的死因是溺水。

sentences.en: An autopsy revealed the woman had sexual intercourse just prior to her murder, but it could not be determined if she had been raped or if it was consensual.
sentences.zh: 尸检显示该女子在遇害前不久曾发生过性行为，但无法确定她是被强奸还是自愿的。

sentences.en: When tyre marks were discovered leading to the lake's shoreline from the surrounding woodland, a horrifying picture began to emerge.
sentences.zh: 当发现有轮胎印从周边树林延伸至湖岸时，一幅令人毛骨悚然的画面开始显现。

sentences.en: The woman had been undressed, restrained and gagged, then dragged from a car to the lake and thrown in while still alive.
sentences.zh: 该女子被脱光衣服、捆绑并塞住嘴巴，然后从车里拖到湖边，在活着的时候被扔了进去。

sentences.en: The following morning, a man named Mato Horvath reported his wife missing.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，一个名叫马托·霍尔瓦特的男子报案称妻子失踪。

sentences.en: Marika Horvath had failed to return home after catching a bus into Salzburg two nights prior.
sentences.zh: 玛丽卡·霍尔瓦特在两天前乘巴士前往萨尔茨堡后一直未归家。

sentences.en: Mato was taken to see the body of the woman recovered from the lake and was devastated to find that she was his wife, Marika.
sentences.zh: 马托被带去辨认从湖中打捞上来的女性遗体，当他发现死者正是他的妻子玛丽卡时，悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: At the time, Austria had one of the lowest violent crime rates in the world and murders were virtually unheard of.
sentences.zh: 当时，奥地利是世界上暴力犯罪率最低的国家之一，谋杀案几乎闻所未闻。

sentences.en: Catching Marika's killer was of the utmost importance, so the country's top detectives were assigned to the case and no expenses were spared.
sentences.zh: 抓获玛丽卡遇害案的凶手至关重要，因此该国顶尖的侦探们被指派负责此案，并且不惜一切代价。

sentences.en: Despite this, a lack of leads and physical evidence had authorities coming up empty.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，由于缺乏线索和物证，当局一无所获。

sentences.en: Over time, the investigation dwindled and the murder gradually faded from public attention.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，调查逐渐陷入停顿，这起谋杀案也渐渐淡出公众视野。

sentences.en: But it remained firmly in the mind of investigating officer August Schanner.
sentences.zh: 但它始终深深印在调查警官奥古斯特·沙纳尔的脑海中。

sentences.en: Although he couldn't find the man responsible,
sentences.zh: 尽管他找不到幕后真凶，

sentences.en: August was certain of one thing.
sentences.zh: 奥古斯特有一点深信不疑。

sentences.en: Whoever killed Marika was a sadistic monster.
sentences.zh: 杀害玛丽卡的凶手是一个虐待狂恶魔。

sentences.en: When he later learned about the murder of Margaret Schaffer in Germany,
sentences.zh: 当他后来得知德国发生玛格丽特·沙法尔谋杀案时，

sentences.en: August was struck by the similarities her case bore to that of Marika Horvath.
sentences.zh: 奥古斯特惊讶地发现这起案件与玛丽卡·霍尔瓦特案有着诸多相似之处。

sentences.en: He sat in on Jack Unterweger's trial, taking in every detail.
sentences.zh: 他旁听了杰克·翁特韦格的审判，不放过任何一个细节。

sentences.en: The more he heard, the more certain he was that Jack was the man he'd been looking for.
sentences.zh: 他听到的越多，就越确信杰克正是他一直在寻找的人。

sentences.en: But he didn't have enough evidence to charge him.
sentences.zh: 但他没有足够的证据起诉他。

sentences.en: As Jack's sentence was read aloud to the court,
sentences.zh: 随着法庭宣读杰克的判决书，

sentences.en: August Schanner took comfort in the fact that at least Jack was now facing life behind bars.
sentences.zh: 奥古斯特·沙纳尔感到一丝慰藉，至少杰克现在面临的是铁窗余生。

sentences.en: On June 19, 1991, 15 years after Jack Unterweger went to prison,
sentences.zh: 1991年6月19日，杰克·翁特韦格入狱15年后，

sentences.en: 20-year-old Shannon Exley stood on the corner of 7th and Main in downtown Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 20岁的香农·埃克斯利站在洛杉矶市中心第7街和主街的转角处。

sentences.en: Behind her, the sign for the Cecil Hotel was brightly illuminated in the night sky.
sentences.zh: 在她身后，塞西尔酒店的招牌在夜空中熠熠生辉。

sentences.en: Shannon had been working in the sex industry since she had run away from home at the age of 16.
sentences.zh: 香农在16岁离家出走后就一直在性产业工作。

sentences.en: She used her earnings to support her drug habit, but earlier that night she'd called her father,
sentences.zh: 她用赚来的钱维持毒瘾，但在当晚早些时候，她给父亲打了电话，

sentences.en: telling him she was going to get her life back on track and was looking forward to a brighter future.
sentences.zh: 告诉他自己要重回正轨，并对光明的未来充满期待。

sentences.en: Just after midnight, a car pulled up alongside her.
sentences.zh: 刚过午夜，一辆汽车停在她身旁。

sentences.en: Shannon hopped in.
sentences.zh: 香农跳上了车。

sentences.en: The next morning, a group of girls were picking up trash behind the parking lot of the girls' scout centre,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，一群女孩在女童子军中心停车场后面捡垃圾，

sentences.en: two and a half miles from where Shannon had been standing the night before.
sentences.zh: 这里距离香农前一晚站立的地方有两英里半。

sentences.en: As they worked, the girls noticed something lying in a vacant, overgrown lot approximately 50 feet beyond the car park.
sentences.zh: 在干活时，女孩们注意到距离停车场大约50英尺远的一处荒废的长满杂草的空地上有什么东西躺着。

sentences.en: They drew closer to get a better look.
sentences.zh: 她们走近以便看个清楚。

sentences.en: It was the body of a murdered woman.
sentences.zh: 那是一具被谋杀的女性尸体。

sentences.en: Shannon Exley was lying on her stomach underneath a tall eucalyptus tree.
sentences.zh: 香农·埃克斯利趴在一棵高大的桉树下。

sentences.en: She was naked, except for a t-shirt that had ridden up around her shoulders and a pair of bright blue socks.
sentences.zh: 她一丝不挂，只穿着一件卷到肩膀上的T恤和一双亮蓝色的袜子。

sentences.en: Around her neck was her bra, tied tight in a series of unique and complex knots.
sentences.zh: 她的脖子上缠着她的胸罩，被紧紧系成了一系列独特而复杂的结。

sentences.en: Whoever had attacked Shannon had used her bra to strangle her.
sentences.zh: 袭击香农的人用她的胸罩勒死了她。

sentences.en: Cuts and scrapes on her feet indicated she'd been dragged through the vacant lot, then dumped.
sentences.zh: 她脚上的割伤和擦伤表明她曾被拖过那片空地，然后被抛尸。

sentences.en: Semen from a number of different men was extracted from Shannon's body.
sentences.zh: 从香农体内提取出了几名不同男性的精液。

sentences.en: None matched DNA profiles of anyone on record.
sentences.zh: 没有一个与任何备案的DNA档案相匹配。

sentences.en: The murder had been carried out in a clean, meticulous fashion and there was no evidence left at the scene.
sentences.zh: 这起谋杀案手法干净利落、一丝不苟，现场没有留下任何证据。

sentences.en: Detectives concluded that the killer must have planned the slaying, scoping out the area in daylight as it was not a sight clearly visible at night.
sentences.zh: 侦探们推断凶手一定是精心策划了这场谋杀，并在白天对该地区进行了踩点，因为这里在夜间并不显眼。

sentences.en: It was a puzzling location.
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人匪夷所思的地点。

sentences.en: Detectives knew that the city's sex workers rarely travelled more than a block or two from where they were picked up.
sentences.zh: 侦探们知道，该市的性工作者很少会走到距离她们被接走的地方超过一两个街区的地方。

sentences.en: The distance from Shannon's last known location suggested she had not gone to the lot willingly.
sentences.zh: 距离香农最后已知地点的距离表明她并非自愿前往那片空地。

sentences.en: Ten days later, a homeless man was looking for firewood one and a half miles from where Shannon Exley was found.
sentences.zh: 十天后，一名无家可归的男子在距离发现香农·埃克斯利尸体一英里半的地方寻找柴火。

sentences.en: As he searched around the parking lot of a freight company, he noticed something beneath a big rigged trailer.
sentences.zh: 当他在一家货运公司的停车场周围搜寻时，他注意到一辆大型拖挂卡车下面有什么东西。

sentences.en: It was the body of a woman, lying on her back and naked aside from a t-shirt and one sock.
sentences.zh: 那是一具女性尸体，仰面躺着，赤身裸体，只穿了一件T恤和一只袜子。

sentences.en: She had been hit in the abdomen so forcefully that it caused internal damage.
sentences.zh: 她的腹部曾遭受猛烈击打，导致了内脏损伤。

sentences.en: But the cause of her death was ligature strangulation.
sentences.zh: 但她的死因是勒颈窒息。

sentences.en: The woman's own bra was knotted tightly around her neck.
sentences.zh: 死者自己的胸罩紧紧系在她的脖子上。

sentences.en: Her name was Irene Rodriguez and she was 33 years old.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫艾琳·罗德里格斯，年仅33岁。

sentences.en: Irene had been in Los Angeles for less than three months, performing sex work to support a heroin addiction.
sentences.zh: 艾琳来到洛杉矶不到三个月，靠从事性工作来维持海洛因瘾。

sentences.en: She left behind a husband and four children.
sentences.zh: 她留下了一个丈夫和四个孩子。

sentences.en: Irene had worked on the same corner as Shannon, just down the road from the Cecil Hotel.
sentences.zh: 艾琳曾在与香农相同的街角工作，就在塞西尔酒店顺路不远的地方。

sentences.en: Just as in Shannon's murder, her killer left no evidence and a forensic examination resulted in zero leads.
sentences.zh: 就像香农被害案一样，她的凶手没有留下任何证据，法医检验也没有提供任何线索。

sentences.en: Detectives suspected Irene's attacker may have been a trucker from out of town, given where her body had been dumped.
sentences.zh: 鉴于抛尸地点，侦探们怀疑艾琳的袭击者可能是外地的卡车司机。

sentences.en: Sex workers who frequented the area where Shannon and Irene were taken were worried.
sentences.zh: 经常出入香农和艾琳被带走区域的性工作者们感到很担忧。

sentences.en: Many were friends, and word spread quickly amongst their community that two women had been killed while working.
sentences.zh: 许多人都是朋友，两名女性在工作时遇害的消息在她们的群体中迅速传开。

sentences.en: Some shared their fears with a journalist who was writing a series of articles on the dangers of sex work in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 一些人将她们的恐惧倾诉给了一位记者，该记者当时正在撰写一系列关于洛杉矶性工作危险性的文章。

sentences.en: Known for his compassionate understanding of controversial topics, he wrote an article about the murdered women for Tiroline magazine.
sentences.zh: 他以对争议话题富有同情心的理解而闻名，他为《蒂罗林》杂志写了一篇关于遇害女性的文章。

sentences.en: An excerpt of which read,
sentences.zh: 其中的摘录写道：

sentences.en: Real life in LA is dominated by a tough struggle for survival, by the broken dreams of thousands who come to the city, and an equal number who leave, sometimes dead.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶的现实生活充斥着残酷的生存斗争、数千名来到这座城市却梦想破灭的人，以及同样数量离开这里的人，有时他们是以死者的身份离开的。

sentences.en: Sex workers who knew Shannon Exley and Irene Rodriguez opened up to the sympathetic journalist, describing how the murders had impacted them,
sentences.zh: 认识香农·埃克斯利和艾琳·罗德里格斯的性工作者们向这位富有同情心的记者敞开心扉，讲述了这些谋杀案对她们的影响，

sentences.en: and crying over the loss of their friends.
sentences.zh: 并为失去朋友而痛哭。

sentences.en: It's ugly.
sentences.zh: 这很丑陋。

sentences.en: It's dirty.
sentences.zh: 这很肮脏。

sentences.en: It's scary.
sentences.zh: 这很可怕。

sentences.en: Every time you walk out on the street, you take your life in your hands.
sentences.zh: 每次你走上街头，都是在拿自己的生命冒险。

sentences.en: You could die every time you get in a car.
sentences.zh: 每次你坐进车里，你都可能面临死亡。

sentences.en: Every time you drive away, you don't know this person.
sentences.zh: 每次你开车离开，你都不认识这个人。

sentences.en: You don't know if he's going to kill you.
sentences.zh: 你根本不知道他会不会杀了你。

sentences.en: Two weeks after the murder of Irene Rodriguez, a deputy sheriff drove to a deserted Malibu hilltop in response to a frantic call received by the LA County Sheriff's Department.
sentences.zh: 艾琳·罗德里格斯遇害两周后，一名副警长驱车前往马里布荒凉的山顶，以回应洛杉矶县警长办公室接到的一通慌乱的求助电话。

sentences.en: As described in John Lake's book, Entering Hades, the deputy was met at the scene by a group of men and their children.
sentences.zh: 正如约翰·莱克在其著作《进入哈迪斯》中所描述的那样，这名副警长在现场遇到了几名男子和他们的孩子。

sentences.en: They'd headed there to view a solar eclipse that was set to black out the Los Angeles skyline by mid-morning.
sentences.zh: 他们前往那里是为了观看预计在上午中旬遮蔽洛杉矶天际线的日食。

sentences.en: Instead, they had stumbled across the body of a dead woman.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们无意中发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She was lying on her back with her shirt up around her shoulders, exposing her breasts.
sentences.zh: 她仰面躺着，衬衫卷到肩膀上，胸部裸露在外。

sentences.en: Otherwise, she was fully clothed.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，她衣着完整。

sentences.en: Her fingerprints identified her as Peggy Booth, a sex worker who worked on Hollywood's Sunset Boulevard, approximately seven miles from where Shannon and Irene were picked up.
sentences.zh: 通过指纹确认死者是佩吉·布斯，她是一名在好莱坞日落大道工作的性工作者，距离香农和艾琳被接走的地方大约七英里。

sentences.en: Detectives assumed Peggy must have known her murderer well, as the desolate location where she was found was not a place she would usually frequent.
sentences.zh: 侦探们推测，佩吉一定很熟悉凶手，因为发现她尸体的荒凉地点并不是她平时常去的地方。

sentences.en: Just like Shannon and Irene, Peggy had been strangled to death with her own bra.
sentences.zh: 就像香农和艾琳一样，佩吉也是用她自己的胸罩被勒死的。

sentences.en: While the murder of sex workers in Los Angeles was tragically not a rare occurrence, this identical manner of killing was.
sentences.zh: 虽然在洛杉矶，谋杀性工作者的情况并不罕见，但这几种完全相同的作案手法却很罕见。

sentences.en: Dr. Lynn Herold from the LA County Sheriff's Department analysed the ligatures.
sentences.zh: 来自洛杉矶县治安官部门的琳恩·赫罗德博士对勒痕进行了分析。

sentences.en: In the hundreds of strangulation murders Dr. Herold had seen over the course of her career,
sentences.zh: 在赫罗德博士职业生涯中见过的数百起勒死谋杀案中，

sentences.en: these three were the only ones she had come across where a victim had been strangled by their own undergarments.
sentences.zh: 这三起是她仅见的受害者被自己的内衣勒死的案件。

sentences.en: The fact that the victim's bras had all been dismantled and tied together in the exact same way left her in no doubt that the same person was responsible for all three murders.
sentences.zh: 受害者的胸罩都被拆开并以完全相同的方式系在一起，这让她毫不怀疑这三起谋杀案都是同一个人所为。

sentences.en: Detectives began surveilling downtown haunts where sex workers were known to operate in case the killer struck again.
sentences.zh: 侦探们开始监视市中心性工作者常去的场所，以防凶手再次作案。

sentences.en: But he never did.
sentences.zh: 但他再也没有出现。

sentences.en: On July 16, 1991, the journalist who had reported on the slayings in Los Angeles boarded a flight back to his home country.
sentences.zh: 1991年7月16日，那位曾报道洛杉矶谋杀案的记者登上了返回祖国的航班。

sentences.en: He'd gathered ample material for his work comparing the differences between sex work in LA and Europe
sentences.zh: 他收集了充足的材料，用于比较洛杉矶和欧洲性工作差异的作品

sentences.en: and intended to broadcast these findings in a radio series for the Austrian Broadcasting Corporation.
sentences.zh: 并打算在奥地利广播公司的电台系列节目中广播这些调查结果。

sentences.en: He also planned to write several articles on the same topic.
sentences.zh: 他还计划就同一主题写几篇文章。

sentences.en: It was a busy time for the journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 对这位记者来说，这是一段忙碌的时光。

sentences.en: In addition to his investigative deep dive, he also had a book to promote with public signings.
sentences.zh: 除了深入调查之外，他还有一本书要通过公开签名售书来进行宣传。

sentences.en: In his homeland, the journalist was a beloved public figure with thousands of fans who adored his empathetic writing style.
sentences.zh: 在他的祖国，这位记者是一位深受爱戴的公众人物，拥有数千名崇拜他那富有同情心的写作风格的粉丝。

sentences.en: He considered himself a ladies' man and picked up women effortlessly, even having a whirlwind romance with one of the Cecil Hotel's receptionists.
sentences.zh: 他自认为是个情圣，能毫不费力地泡到女人，甚至与塞西尔酒店的一名前台接待员有过一段旋风般的恋情。

sentences.en: She hoped to visit him in Austria soon.
sentences.zh: 她希望很快能去奥地利看望他。

sentences.en: The journalist was Jack Unterweger.
sentences.zh: 这名记者就是杰克·恩特韦格。

sentences.en: Jack Unterweger's prison sentence for the murder of Margaret Schaffer, who he had abducted and strangled to death in 1974,
sentences.zh: 杰克·恩特韦格因谋杀玛格丽特·谢弗而被判入狱，他在1974年绑架并勒死了她，

sentences.en: coincided with the period of reform in Austria's penal system.
sentences.zh: 这段刑期恰逢奥地利监狱系统改革时期。

sentences.en: The nation's Minister for Justice implemented a program based on the theory that even the most violent criminals could be successfully rehabilitated whilst incarcerated.
sentences.zh: 国家司法部长实施了一项计划，其理论基础是，即使是最暴力的罪犯，在服刑期间也能被成功改造。

sentences.en: One prisoner who took advantage of the new opportunities offered was Jack Unterweger.
sentences.zh: 充分利用这些新机遇的囚犯之一就是杰克·恩特韦格。

sentences.en: He became a regular at the prison library, teaching himself to read and write.
sentences.zh: 他成了监狱图书馆的常客，自学识字和写作。

sentences.en: Over time, he discovered that he had a natural talent for the written word.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他发现自己在文字方面有着天分。

sentences.en: He began writing plays, poetry and short stories for children.
sentences.zh: 他开始为儿童写戏剧、诗歌和短篇小说。

sentences.en: While he remained behind bars, his short stories were broadcast over the radio, to the delight of many parents and children who tuned in.
sentences.zh: 当他仍在狱中时，他的短篇小说在电台播出，令许多收听的父母和孩子欣喜不已。

sentences.en: In 1983, eight years into his sentence,
sentences.zh: 1983年，他服刑八年后，

sentences.en: Jack Unterweger completed his autobiography entitled it Fiegerfeuer, which translates to purgatory in English.
sentences.zh: 杰克·恩特韦格完成了他的自传，名为《Fiegerfeuer》，英语翻译为炼狱。

sentences.en: Jack told of his tragic childhood and the despair of prison life, neglecting to mention why he was imprisoned.
sentences.zh: 杰克讲述了他悲惨的童年和监狱生活的绝望，却闭口不谈自己为何入狱。

sentences.en: The book was published later that year and became a bestseller.
sentences.zh: 这本书于当年晚些时候出版，并成为了畅销书。

sentences.en: People felt connected to Jack and his compassionate descriptions of life behind bars.
sentences.zh: 人们感觉得到了杰克的共鸣，以及他对铁窗后生活的富有同情心的描述。

sentences.en: He seemed relatable, genuine and sensitive.
sentences.zh: 他显得平易近人、真诚而敏感。

sentences.en: But police inspector August Schenner hadn't forgotten about Marika Horvath, the woman who drowned in Salzburg Lake.
sentences.zh: 但警务督察奥古斯特·舍纳并没有忘记玛丽卡·霍瓦特，那个在萨尔茨堡湖溺水的女子。

sentences.en: He remained convinced that Jack Unterweger was responsible and arranged to interview him in prison.
sentences.zh: 他坚信杰克·恩特韦格是罪魁祸首，并安排在监狱里对进行他进行讯问。

sentences.en: A girlfriend of Jack's had written a statement placing them in Salzburg on the night of Marika's murder.
sentences.zh: 杰克的一个女友曾写下一份证词，证明他们在玛丽卡被谋杀的那天晚上在萨尔茨堡。

sentences.en: She recalled that Jack had left without explanation for a period of the night and also remembered Jack keeping newspaper clippings about the murder.
sentences.zh: 她回忆说，杰克在当晚曾有一段时间不告而别，并且还记得杰克保留了关于这起谋杀案的剪报。

sentences.en: When she pressed him for information about the clippings, he threw them away.
sentences.zh: 每当她追问有关剪报的事时，他就把它们扔掉。

sentences.en: When August Schenner confronted Jack with this information in prison, he burst into tears and told the investigator that if this line of questioning continued,
sentences.zh: 当奥古斯特·舍纳尔在监狱里拿这些情况质问杰克时，他失声痛哭，并对调查人员说，如果这种审讯继续下去，

sentences.en: he would return to his cell and hang himself.
sentences.zh: 他就会回到牢房上吊自杀。

sentences.en: Undeterred, Inspector Schenner appealed to the district attorney to prosecute Jack for Marika's murder.
sentences.zh: 舍纳尔督察并未气馁，他向地区检察官呼吁起诉杰克谋杀玛丽卡。

sentences.en: As per Austrian law, Jack could only serve one life sentence.
sentences.zh: 按照奥地利法律，杰克只能服刑一次终身监禁。

sentences.en: But if he was found guilty of killing Marika, time would be added to his current term.
sentences.zh: 但如果他被裁定谋杀玛丽卡罪名成立，刑期将会叠加到他目前的刑期中。

sentences.en: The district attorney declined to proceed with the case, telling Inspector Schenner,
sentences.zh: 地区检察官拒绝继续推进此案，并对舍纳尔督察说：

sentences.en: he already has a life sentence.
sentences.zh: 他已经背负了终身监禁。

sentences.en: He can only be given one.
sentences.zh: 他只能被判处一次。

sentences.en: It was suggested that his decision was influenced by the strong links Jack had to prominent Austrians, who wholeheartedly enjoyed his body of work.
sentences.zh: 有人认为，他的决定受到了杰克与奥地利名流之间紧密联系的影响，那些人全心全意地欣赏他的作品。

sentences.en: Although Inspector Schenner was outraged, he had nowhere else to turn.
sentences.zh: 尽管舍纳尔督察怒不可遏，但他已别无去处。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before Fiegerfeuer caught the attention of Austria's literary elite.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，《菲格尔弗尔》就引起了奥地利文学精英们的关注。

sentences.en: They praised the autobiography, describing it as the ultimate example of the power the arts had to transform lives.
sentences.zh: 他们盛赞这部自传，将其形容为艺术改变生命力量的终极例证。

sentences.en: Those responsible for the country's prison reform held up Jack Unterweger as their greatest success story.
sentences.zh: 负责该国监狱改革的人士将杰克·翁特韦格奉为最伟大的成功典范。

sentences.en: In 1984, Jack received an award for his work, a stage production titled Terminal Prison.
sentences.zh: 1984年，杰克因他的作品——一部名为《绝命监狱》的舞台剧而获奖。

sentences.en: He was permitted day release to attend the opening night performance and arrived to a throng of photographers clamouring to take his picture.
sentences.zh: 他获准出狱一天以参加首演之夜的演出，抵达时迎来了蜂拥而至、争相给他拍照的摄影师。

sentences.en: In 1985, Austria's literary community began to petition for Jack's early release.
sentences.zh: 1985年，奥地利文学界开始请愿要求提前释放杰克。

sentences.en: His editor recalled a reading Jack gave in Stein Prison, stating, At his reading, he was so tender, and at that moment we decided we had to get him pardoned.
sentences.zh: 他的编辑回忆起杰克在施泰因监狱的一次朗读时说：“在朗读时，他是那么温柔，就在那一刻，我们决定必须让他获得特赦。”

sentences.en: But Austrian President Rudolf Kurschlager refused to sign off on Jack's release, pointing out that he was legally required to serve at least 15 years of his life sentence.
sentences.zh: 但奥地利总统鲁道夫·克施拉格拒绝签署释放杰克的命令，并指出法律规定他必须至少服满15年的终身监禁。

sentences.en: In 1988, Jack's autobiography was adapted into a film.
sentences.zh: 1988年，杰克的自传被改编成电影。

sentences.en: He collaborated with its director, but differences in artistic vision became evident when Jack continually requested to be portrayed as a hero.
sentences.zh: 他与导演进行了合作，但当杰克不断要求把自己塑造成英雄时，双方在艺术愿景上的分歧便显现出来了。

sentences.en: The director disagreed, unable to look past Jack's conviction for murder.
sentences.zh: 导演并不同意，无法忽视杰克因谋杀而被定罪的事实。

sentences.en: He believed Jack had a massive ego and only used his writing as a means to escape prison, later telling British newspaper The Guardian,
sentences.zh: 他认为杰克有着极度膨胀的自我，只是把写作当作逃离监狱的手段，后来他告诉英国《卫报》：

sentences.en: Jack doesn't like literature.
sentences.zh: 杰克不喜欢文学。

sentences.en: Jack doesn't like writers.
sentences.zh: 杰克不喜欢作家。

sentences.en: Jack doesn't like anything.
sentences.zh: 杰克什么也不喜欢。

sentences.en: Jack only likes Jack.
sentences.zh: 杰克只喜欢杰克。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the film was released to positive reviews, and as the movie gained popularity and Jack's book was taught in Austrian high schools,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，电影上映后获得了好评，随着电影的普及以及杰克的书被纳入奥地利高中的教材，

sentences.en: support for his release only increased.
sentences.zh: 支持释放他的呼声愈发高涨。

sentences.en: On May 23 1990,
39-year-old Jack Unterweger left prison as a free man, having served his minimum term of 15 years.
sentences.zh: 39岁的杰克·翁特韦格在服满15年的最低刑期后，作为自由人走出了监狱。

sentences.en: His release was due in part to the campaigning of psychiatrist Dr Ernest Bornemann, who never met Jack, but had read his autobiography.
sentences.zh: 他得以获释，部分归功于精神病学家恩斯特·博尔内曼博士的奔走呼吁，博尔内曼从未见过杰克，但读过他的自传。

sentences.en: Dr Bornemann wrote a letter to the justice minister, which read in part,
sentences.zh: 博尔内曼博士写信给司法部长，其中写道：

sentences.en: The man committed a serious act, is remorseful, understands the motive of his actions at the time, and has the means never to have a relapse.
sentences.zh: 此人犯下了严重的罪行，但深有悔意，理解当时行为的动机，并且具备绝不重犯的条件。

sentences.en: I am convinced that this act will never be committed again.
sentences.zh: 我确信这种行为将永远不会再次发生。

sentences.en: Upon Jack's release, one prison warden said,
sentences.zh: 在杰克获释时，一位监狱长说道：

sentences.en: We will never find a prisoner so well prepared for freedom.
sentences.zh: 我们再也找不到一个对自由准备得如此充分的囚犯了。

sentences.en: A psychologist at Stein Prison who was straight out of university had an hour-long conversation with Jack and wrote that he was now fit for society, having worked on his problems
sentences.zh: 施泰因监狱的一位刚毕业不久的心理学家与杰克进行了长达一小时的谈话，并写道，他现在已经适合回归社会，并且已经解决了自己的问题

sentences.en: with intellectual rigour.
sentences.zh: 带有严密的智识逻辑。

sentences.en: Jack Unterweger was welcomed back into the community with open arMs.
sentences.zh: 杰克·翁特韦格受到社区的夹道欢迎。

sentences.en: He settled into an apartment in Vienna and bought a German shepherd he named Joy.
sentences.zh: 他在维也纳安顿下来，买了一只名叫“乔伊”的德国牧羊犬。

sentences.en: When Jack walked down the street and ate at cafes, he was constantly interrupted by people wanting to talk to him.
sentences.zh: 当杰克走在街上或在咖啡馆用餐时，总是不断被人打扰，人们都想跟他交谈。

sentences.en: He soaked up this newfound celebrity status.
sentences.zh: 他尽情享受这种失而复得的名人身份。

sentences.en: Soon, Jack was given a job as a reporter with the Austrian Broadcasting Corporation.
sentences.zh: 不久，杰克在奥地利广播公司找到了一份记者工作。

sentences.en: He went to photo shoots, sometimes posing shirtless, to reveal the prison tattoos that covered his torso.
sentences.zh: 他去参加摄影，有时甚至赤裸上身，展示覆盖了他整个躯干的监狱纹身。

sentences.en: On one occasion, he thought it would be amusing to take a series of photos posing with a noose around his neck.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他觉得拍一组脖子上套着绞索的写真会很有意思。

sentences.en: Jack attended book signings and gave public poetry readings.
sentences.zh: 杰克参加新书签售会，并公开朗诵诗歌。

sentences.en: He became a regular on magazine covers and talk shows.
sentences.zh: 他成了杂志封面和脱口秀节目的常客。

sentences.en: A fortnight after being released from prison, he appeared on the popular national television program Club 2 and debated the topic of penal reform with other esteemed authors.
sentences.zh: 出狱两周后，他出现在受欢迎的国家电视节目《2号俱乐部》上，与多位受人尊敬的作家探讨刑罚改革的话题。

sentences.en: The panellists described Jack as an exception to the prison rehabilitation program, which had since been deemed unsuccessful for 99% of inmates.
sentences.zh: 小组成员将杰克描述为监狱改造项目的一个例外，该项目当时已被认为对99%的犯人无效。

sentences.en: In response, Jack said, They fail.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，杰克说：“他们失败了。”

sentences.en: They end up in homeless shelters because they don't have the inner strength to fend for themselves.
sentences.zh: “他们最终流落到收容所，因为他们没有自食其力的内在力量。”

sentences.en: It was less than four months after Jack Luntovega's release that the murders of vulnerable women began.
sentences.zh: 在杰克·伦托维加出狱不到四个月后，针对弱势女性的谋杀案就开始了。

sentences.en: Regina Prem was a sex worker in Vienna, Austria, who provided for herself and her husband, Rudolf, as well as their young child.
sentences.zh: 雷吉娜·普雷姆是奥地利维也纳的一名性工作者，她要养活自己、丈夫鲁道夫以及他们年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: On the night of April 28, 1991, she had an appointment with a regular client, so Rudolf dropped her off at an intersection in Vienna's red light district.
sentences.zh: 1991年4月28日晚上，她和一个老客户有约，于是鲁道夫把她送到维也纳红灯区的一个十字路口。

sentences.en: She said goodbye to him, then got out of the car.
sentences.zh: 她跟他道别，然后下了车。

sentences.en: Rudolf waited at home for Regina's phone call saying she was ready to be picked up.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫在家等候雷吉娜的电话，说她准备好让人去接了。

sentences.en: Hours ticked by.
sentences.zh: 时间一分一秒地过去了。

sentences.en: When 2am came and went with no call,
sentences.zh: 当凌晨2点到来却依然没有电话时，

sentences.en: Rudolf grew concerned.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫开始担心起来。

sentences.en: He began driving around the city streets in search of his wife, but there was no sign of her.
sentences.zh: 他开始开车在城市街道上寻找他的妻子，但完全不见她的踪影。

sentences.en: A food vendor came forward to say he'd spotted Regina at around 11.30pm, leaving a hotel she often frequented with wealthy clients.
sentences.zh: 一名食品小贩站出来说，他在晚上11点半左右看到雷吉娜离开了一家她经常与富裕客户光顾的酒店。

sentences.en: This was the last confirmed sighting of Regina Prem.
sentences.zh: 这是雷吉娜·普雷姆最后一次被确凿目击。

sentences.en: A month passed with no leads.
sentences.zh: 一个月过去了，没有任何线索。

sentences.en: Rudolf Prem issued a public plea, telling reporters for the Viennese newspaper,
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫·普雷姆向维也纳报纸的记者公开发表呼吁，

sentences.en: Courier.
sentences.zh: 《信使报》。

sentences.en: Quote, I don't want to believe she's dead.
sentences.zh: 他说道：“我不相信她死了。”

sentences.en: Maybe she's been abducted and locked up somewhere.
sentences.zh: “也许她被绑架并关在某个地方。”

sentences.en: But if the lunatic has killed Regina, he should at least say where her body lies.
sentences.zh: “但如果那个疯子杀了雷吉娜，他至少应该说出她的尸体在哪里。”

sentences.en: My wife deserves a decent burial.
sentences.zh: “我的妻子应该得到一场像样的葬礼。”

sentences.en: About five weeks later,
sentences.zh: 大约五周后，

sentences.en: Rudolf was at home when his phone rang.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫在家中时电话铃响了。

sentences.en: He answered it.
sentences.zh: 他接起了电话。

sentences.en: A male voice on the other end said, At the Vienna Woods Lake, go left and follow the path that steeply ascends and forks.
sentences.zh: 电话那头是一个男人的声音：“去维也纳森林湖，向左走，沿着那条陡峭上升并有分叉的小路走。”

sentences.en: A few are lying there.
sentences.zh: “有几个人正躺在那里。”

sentences.en: When the figure eight at the Zenith stands, then I'll tell you where your wife lies.
sentences.zh: “当顶峰出现数字‘8’时，我就会告诉你你的妻子躺在哪里。”

sentences.en: Rudolf abruptly hung up the call, believing he was a cruel hoaxer.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫猛地挂断了电话，认为这是一个恶劣的恶作剧。

sentences.en: He didn't report the incident to the police.
sentences.zh: 他没有向警方报告这一事件。

sentences.en: At 11.45pm on October 8, 1991,
Rudolf Pram received another call.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫·普拉姆接到了另一个电话。

sentences.en: The same voice from three months earlier stated,
sentences.zh: 三个月前的同一个人说道：

sentences.en: I am an executioner.
sentences.zh: “我是一名行刑者。”

sentences.en: On Tulbinger Hill lies Gerda.
sentences.zh: “格尔达躺在图尔宾格山上。”

sentences.en: God commanded me to do it.
sentences.zh: “上帝命令我这么做的。”

sentences.en: Tonight, I have completed my work.
sentences.zh: “今晚，我已经完成了我的工作。”

sentences.en: To 11.00pm I have carried out the just punishment.
sentences.zh: “到晚上11点，我已经执行了正义的惩罚。”

sentences.en: Five hours later, the phone rang once more.
sentences.zh: 五小时后，电话再次响起。

sentences.en: Again, the anonymous man spoke.
sentences.zh: 那个匿名男子又开口了。

sentences.en: They lie in the place of atonement facing downward toward Hades because otherwise it would have been an outrage.
sentences.zh: “她们趴着躺在救赎之地，面向冥界，因为否则这就是一种亵渎。”

sentences.en: Rudolf continued to dismiss these calls.
sentences.zh: 鲁道夫继续对这些电话置之不理。

sentences.en: He had no idea that bodies had recently started turning up in the very area that the caller spoke of.
sentences.zh: 他根本不知道，最近在来电者所说的那个地区开始陆续出现尸体。

sentences.en: The Vienna woods are a 45km stretch of dense woodland that runs through
sentences.zh: 维也纳森林是一片长达45公里的茂密林地，纵贯

sentences.en: Vienna and lower Austria.
sentences.zh: 维也纳和下奥地利州。

sentences.en: The forested expanse is a popular destination for those wishing to escape city life.
